sources.title: Qwen 2.1 Turbo (Official) - ComfyUI Cloud
sources.snippet: In the additional files is a (very small) text encoder model, q3_k Qwen3 VL 8B, with vision tower intact but the lm_head removed. This means it cannot do prompt enhancement. It's gguf, so you'd need ComfyUI-GGUF or similar to load it in ComfyUI. Someone requested a text encoder smaller than 4gb. I tried q2_k but it was basically unusable.

sources.title: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo · 8 steps · ComfyUI workflow
sources.snippet: All three files are on Hugging Face in Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1. If you already use Qwen-Image 2.1, you only need the Turbo model. How to use Drag the workflow into ComfyUI. Write your prompt and pick a size. Run Settings Everything is already set: 8 steps, cfg 1, euler, with the sigma schedule Turbo was trained on (in a ManualSigmas node).

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo: Official 8-Step Turbo in ComfyUI
sources.snippet: Alibaba's official Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo checkpoint runs the 7B generator and editor in 8 denoising steps at CFG 1, with Comfy-Org repackaged weights for ComfyUI.
